High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 9696 of 2024
Applicant :- Usman

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko 3 Others

Counsel for Applicant :- Sandeep Kumar(Trivedi), Manish Kumar Yadav Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
None turned up on behalf of the complainant despite service of notice.

2. In terms of the FIR filed on 29.05.2024, it was alleged that the daughter of the informant aged about 17 years met the applicant around two months ago, who allegedly committed wrong on her and also threatened her, as such, the victim did not inform to anyone.
Subsequently, when the victim informed the entire facts, the FIR in question was lodged.
In the statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C., the victim reiterated the said version as also under Section 164 Cr.P.C.

The medical report on record records that the victim was pregnant and the tentative age of the victim is around 17 years.
Usman vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy.

1 3.
The counsel for the applicant based upon the instructions received states that the applicant is ready and willing to marry the victim and it was a case of consent.
4. Learned A.G.A. opposed the bail prayer.
5. Considering the said offer, the applicant is enlarged on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Usman be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No. 368 of 2024, under Sections 376, 504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Pihani, District Hardoi, on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall file an affidavit before the trial Court with regard to the solemnization of marriage.
In case the applicant resiles from his undertaking, the victim would be at liberty to file a bail cancellation application.

(b) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(c) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (d) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.

Order Date :- 13.9.2024 Arun  Usman vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko 3 ... on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/188623743/
